criteria.text: States that the lock-up expires on 25 September 2027 (365 days after the 25 September 2026 Prospectus date).
Identifies the inconsistency between 88,000,000 shares in issue in the Prospectus and 89,250,000 in the Underwriting Agreement recital, which must be reconciled before pricing.
Identifies that 15% of 16,000,000 Firm Shares is 2,400,000 shares, not the 3,200,000 stated in the Over-allotment Option (Clause 4).
Flags the share-count inconsistency between the Prospectus and the Underwriting Agreement.
Shows the over-allotment arithmetic (15% x 16,000,000 = 2,400,000) and flags the discrepancy.
Identifies required third-party, board or regulatory consents/approvals and whether each has been obtained.
